defects.title: Registry-mode Doctor records global-inbox findings before its result accumulator exists
defects.defect_class: diagnostic initialization order / registry-only execution path
defects.preconditions: Multi-Hub instances.json exists, so Invoke-Doctor enters the registry-specific global Hub inbox diagnostic block.
defects.bad_behavior: Invoke-Doctor calls Add-DoctorFinding with $rows before $rows is initialized. The first call throws because the ArrayList parameter is null; the catch path immediately calls Add-DoctorFinding with the same null accumulator and Doctor aborts before normal diagnostics. Single-instance Doctor remains unaffected, which allowed production acceptance to pass while multi-Hub remained inactive.
defects.root_cause: A registry-specific diagnostic block was inserted before function-local diagnostic state initialization, and the permanent convergence regression verified the presence/semantics of the global-inbox Doctor branch without executing Doctor end-to-end in a registry-active state.
